gates.title: Five preset demos and installation parity
gates.done: Five independent free client-transfer stores have matching catalogs (138 products, 482 variants, 367 product images), 46 collections, 21 supporting pages, 18 illustrated articles, campaign files and native menus. Configured JSON and corrected header defaults are deployed to all five unpublished themes. Shared renderer parity passes. Evidence: demo-collections/pages/articles/menus and independent-demo-deployment records.
gates.remaining: All five development plans and current charges verified at $0. Test gateways are active. Approved storefront password access works. Limited storefront results are recorded in demo-release-walkthrough-20261019.json. The themes remain unpublished; permanent demo activation, final supporting-page assignment and catalog-wide availability are still open. This does not block creating the requested ZIP, but the demo URLs must show the correct theme before listing launch.

gates.title: Real Shopify services and browser acceptance
gates.done: 40 regression suites pass. Live selected-variant add-to-cart, quantity change, cart total and native checkout handoff verified. Free Test Payment Gateway active. One simulated attempt displayed payment-error recovery. Owner authorized both simulations and renewed permission for the successful retry.
gates.remaining: No successful test order is claimed. Completing a simulated payment is optional additional evidence, not a separately stated Shopify submission requirement. Native cart-to-Shopify-checkout handoff is verified. Service-dependent fixtures (gift cards, pickup, selling plans, high-variant catalog, app blocks, localization/media) and other supported browser engines still need live acceptance coverage; mocked regression tests do not establish provider acceptance.

gates.title: Public documentation and support
gates.done: 266 public merchant guides cover sections, blocks and all 225 theme settings. A public support form is published without required Google sign-in. One labeled test response was recorded and its email notification was received at dylan@bestwebsitebuildergroup.com. Owner confirmed a two-business-day response commitment. Support metadata deployed to all five unpublished preset demos and the benchmark.
gates.remaining: Maintain the public manual and support destination; preserve public documentation access if source-repository distribution changes. Evidence: support-delivery-20261019.json and support-metadata-deployment-20261019.json.

gates.title: Rights, originality and listing approval
gates.done: Owner explicitly confirmed code/asset distribution rights, exclusive Theme Store distribution and the two-business-day support commitment. Third-party notices are included in the package. Evidence: owner-confirmations-20261019.json.
gates.remaining: Final naming/listing approval and distribution arrangement remain. The repository is public and package.json declares ISC; reconcile that with exclusive Theme Store distribution before launch. If the source repository becomes private, move the public manual to an independent public destination first. Declared icon versions do not prove the exact historical source of every icon or image.

gates.title: Merchant editor usability and warning review
gates.done: Every remaining candidate warning has a path, line, hash and disposition. Five large panels have 233 native conditional controls and clearer groups. CTA insertion contrast and disabled comparison presets corrected. No lint checks suppressed.
gates.remaining: 117 high-control schemas generate advisory warnings; these are not 117 demonstrated defects. Representative live editor checks and documented warning dispositions exist. Full manual exploration of every combination is not claimed. Preserve the warning registry and target any observed usability failure.
